trialDeclaration.toolPolicy: read-only lead; direct CodexAppServer pinned to launcher system CODEX_HOME and resolved binary, with profile switching disabled; worker role map cleared before orchestrator construction and A2A route registration; pinned per-thread Codex feature overrides disable the native shell tool, subagent, browser/computer, image, code-mode, and sleep tools, set web_search=disabled, and are asserted with model, sandbox, and approval policy before thread/start or thread/resume; unified_exec may remain true as an implementation detail while shell_tool=false is the command-tool gate; MCP, apps, and plugins disabled; all exact source inputs embedded in the prompt; task workspace empty and mode 0555; no project writes, command execution, or tests
trialDeclaration.budgets: Maximum 8 Codex App Server turn/start submissions per task, enforced before request 9, and 240 seconds from A2A submission; 500000 measured total tokens per task and 4000000 total across eight tasks. Internal modelRequests telemetry remains null when unavailable. Before each task capture active system account usage for evidence, but do not stop based on displayed primary or weekly usage percentages. An explicit provider account-quota exhaustion response stops the cohort; do not retry or switch accounts. Monetary cost is unavailable from subscription telemetry; apply predeclared token, elapsed, and quota proxy thresholds and make no dollar cost or savings claim.
trialDeclaration.scoring: Blind binary case oracle rubric, per-case normalized score, unweighted four-case mean, and separate non-compensable hard gates; exact criteria and formulas are frozen in paired-trial-declaration.md.
trialDeclaration.retentionThresholds: Every skill-on case passes all hard gates; aggregate improves at least 10 percentage points; at least two cases improve; no case regresses by more than 10 points; median non-cached input-token ratio <=1.25 and each pair <=1.50; median total-token ratio <=1.50 and each pair <=2.00; median elapsed ratio <=1.50 and each pair <=2.00. Missing required usage metrics or a zero skill-off denominator makes that resource metric unverified and blocks retention; do not impute undefined ratios. Monetary cost remains null if unavailable; if available, median ratio <=1.25 and every pair <=1.50, with a zero skill-off denominator making cost unverified and blocking retention. Otherwise benefit is not established and feature remains default-off.
